## Change

Describe the concrete problem and the resulting behavior. Identify the affected application.

## Verification

List the actual commands, environment and results. Distinguish focused tests, full package checks, intercepted browser fixtures and deployment checks. Include real screenshots for visible UI changes.

## Evidence and compatibility

State any API/schema changes and how callers are updated. Identify source/input/run versions affected; preserve frozen evidence, original predictions and failed runs.

## Remaining limits

State unresolved prerequisites or checks that were not run. Engineering checks do not establish scientific review, clinical validation or deployment completion.
